name: Minimal-LinuxBench
intro: Minimal-LinuxBench 是 Anthropic 从 Redwood Research 私下共享的 LinuxBench 改编的内部 AI 控制评测：从 1,948 个主任务/副任务对中随机抽取 200 对，检验智能体能否完成副任务且逃过全轨迹监控。
build_method: 私有 LinuxBench 子集改编, 主任务与副任务配对, 随机抽样, 全轨迹监控
metric: 成功隐蔽完成率, 副任务完成率, 监控告警率
eval_feature: 隐蔽副任务, 全轨迹监控, 多提示与监控器对比, Wilson 置信区间
scale: 改编 1,948 对；随机抽取 200 对（有效分母略低于 200）
build_method_en: Private LinuxBench Adaptation, Main/Side-task Pairing, Random Sampling, Full-transcript Monitoring
eval_feature_en: Covert Side Tasks, Full-transcript Monitoring, Prompt and Monitor Comparisons, Wilson Confidence Intervals
intro_en: Minimal-LinuxBench is Anthropic's in-house AI-control evaluation adapted from LinuxBench privately shared by Redwood Research: 200 pairs are randomly sampled from 1,948 adapted main/side-task pairs to test whether an agent completes the side task without detection by a full-transcript monitor.
scale_en: 1,948 pairs adapted; 200 sampled (effective denominator slightly below 200)
metric_en: Successful Stealth Completion Rate, Side-task Completion Rate, Monitor Flag Rate
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the official Claude Mythos Preview System Card Sections 4.4.3.2–4.4.3.3. The diagram limits construction claims to the disclosed private LinuxBench adaptation, 1,948 main/side-task pairs, random 200-pair sample, and slightly smaller effective denominator; it then preserves three attack prompts, no-extended-thinking scope, full-transcript monitoring including assistant turns, completion/flag/stealth outcomes, the 69-completion observation, checkpoint and monitor comparisons, SHADE-Arena-optimized selective prompts, transfer failure analysis, and 95% Wilson intervals.
